content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes banknote validators and security paper for banks and central banks; it is payment and authentication hardware, not gaming content or terminals."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Runs consumer-facing betting brands that take player wagers directly, rather than supplying terminals or content to operators."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Promotes concerts, sells event tickets and operates venues; it is live entertainment with no gaming supply business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Operates bowling centers selling play time to consumers; it is a physical leisure venue business, not gaming supply."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a consumer betting operator with retail shops; its B2B platform services are a side line, not terminal or content supply."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells point-of-sale hardware and software to restaurants and retailers; the customers and products differ from gaming terminals and content."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns and runs casino resorts with hotels and restaurants, earning from walk-in guests rather than supplying gaming equipment or content."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells IP communications and security software to telecom carriers and enterprises; it shares no gaming products or customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates online casino and betting for individual players, earning net wagering results; it is an operator, not a supplier to operators."}]}
